result.instructions: Tools for Amplitude, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which events did we track last week, and how many users triggered each?"; "What is our signup-to-first-purchase conversion rate for the last 30 days?"; "Show weekly retention for users who first opened the app in October.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Amplitude data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run amplitude_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run amplitude_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run amplitude_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. amplitude_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: amplitude_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List the event types of the project, with whether each is marked inactive. Good first call to find event names for the other tools. Dashboard REST API: GET /api/2/events/list.

tools.name: amplitude_event_segmentation
tools.title: Event segmentation
tools.description: Count an event (or compare two events) over a date range, optionally segmented and grouped. Metrics: uniques, totals, pct_dau, average, histogram, sums, value_avg. Dashboard REST API: GET /api/2/events/segmentation.

event_type.description: Event name. Custom events: prefix with ce: (for example ce:Play Song). Special: _active, _all, revenue_amount.

subprop_key.description: Property name. Custom user properties: prefix with gp: (for example gp:SignUpDate).

group_by.description: Up to two properties to group by.

e.description: One event: its type, optional property filters and up to two group-by properties.

event_type.description: Event name. Custom events: prefix with ce: (for example ce:Play Song). Special: _active, _all, revenue_amount.

subprop_key.description: Property name. Custom user properties: prefix with gp: (for example gp:SignUpDate).

group_by.description: Up to two properties to group by.

m.description: Metric (default uniques). histogram, sums and value_avg need a group by on e.

n.description: Which users to count: any or active (default any).

start.description: First date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261001).

end.description: Last date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261031).

i.description: Count interval: -300000 = real-time, -3600000 = hourly, 1 = daily, 7 = weekly, 30 = monthly (default 1).

s.description: Segment definitions: {prop, op, values} for a property, or {type: 'event', op, event_type, ...} for a 'who performed' filter.

g.description: Up to two properties to group by.

tools.name: amplitude_funnel_analysis
tools.title: Funnel analysis
tools.description: Conversion through an ordered list of events (2 or more steps) over a date range. mode: ordered, unordered or sequential. Dashboard REST API: GET /api/2/funnels.

event_type.description: Event name. Custom events: prefix with ce: (for example ce:Play Song). Special: _active, _all, revenue_amount.

subprop_key.description: Property name. Custom user properties: prefix with gp: (for example gp:SignUpDate).

group_by.description: Up to two properties to group by.

items.description: One event: its type, optional property filters and up to two group-by properties.

e.description: The funnel steps, in order: one event per step.

start.description: First date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261001).

end.description: Last date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261031).

n.description: Which users to count: new or active (default active).

tools.name: amplitude_retention_analysis
tools.title: Retention analysis
tools.description: Share of users who return after a start action (for example first use). Use _new or _active as the start, _all or _active as the return. rm: nday, rolling, bracket or nday_or_before. Dashboard REST API: GET /api/2/retention.

event_type.description: Event name. Custom events: prefix with ce: (for example ce:Play Song). Special: _active, _all, revenue_amount.

subprop_key.description: Property name. Custom user properties: prefix with gp: (for example gp:SignUpDate).

group_by.description: Up to two properties to group by.

anyOf.description: One event: its type, optional property filters and up to two group-by properties.

se.description: Start action: _new (new users), _active (all active users), or one event.

event_type.description: Event name. Custom events: prefix with ce: (for example ce:Play Song). Special: _active, _all, revenue_amount.

subprop_key.description: Property name. Custom user properties: prefix with gp: (for example gp:SignUpDate).

group_by.description: Up to two properties to group by.

anyOf.description: One event: its type, optional property filters and up to two group-by properties.

re.description: Return action: _all (any event), _active (any active event), or one event.

start.description: First date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261001).

end.description: Last date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261031).

rb.description: Required when rm is bracket: the day ranges, formatted [[start,end]] (for example [[1,1],[2,7]]).

tools.name: amplitude_active_user_counts
tools.title: Active or new user counts
tools.description: Number of active or new users per day, week or month over a date range, optionally segmented and grouped by one property. Dashboard REST API: GET /api/2/users.

start.description: First date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261001).

end.description: Last date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261031).

m.description: Which users to count: new or active (default active).

s.description: Segment definitions: {prop, op, values} for a property, or {type: 'event', op, event_type, ...} for a 'who performed' filter.

g.description: Property to group by (for example country or gp:plan).

tools.name: amplitude_session_length_distribution
tools.title: Session length distribution
tools.description: Number of sessions per length bucket over a date range. Custom buckets: set the time unit (seconds, minutes, hours, days), min, max and size. Dashboard REST API: GET /api/2/sessions/length.

start.description: First date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261001).

end.description: Last date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261031).

timeHistogramConfigBinMin.description: Lowest bucket value, in the time unit (for example 0).

timeHistogramConfigBinMax.description: Highest bucket value, in the time unit (for example 600).

timeHistogramConfigBinSize.description: Bucket size, in the time unit (for example 60).

tools.name: amplitude_average_session_length
tools.title: Average session length
tools.description: Average session length per day over a date range. Dashboard REST API: GET /api/2/sessions/average.

start.description: First date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261001).

end.description: Last date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261031).

tools.name: amplitude_revenue_ltv
tools.title: Revenue LTV
tools.description: Revenue per user (ARPU), revenue per paying user (ARPPU), total revenue or paying users over a date range. m: 0 = ARPU, 1 = ARPPU, 2 = total revenue, 3 = paying users. Dashboard REST API: GET /api/2/revenue/ltv.

m.description: Metric: 0 ARPU (default), 1 ARPPU, 2 total revenue, 3 paying users.

start.description: First date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261001).

end.description: Last date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261031).

s.description: Segment definitions: {prop, op, values} for a property, or {type: 'event', op, event_type, ...} for a 'who performed' filter.

g.description: Property to group by (for example country or gp:plan).

tools.name: amplitude_property_composition
tools.title: Property composition
tools.description: Breakdown of users by one property (for example country, platform, version or gp:plan) over a date range. Dashboard REST API: GET /api/2/composition.

start.description: First date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261001).

end.description: Last date included, formatted YYYYMMDD (for example 20261031).

p.description: Property to break down by (for example country, platform, or gp:plan).

tools.name: amplitude_search_users
tools.title: Search users
tools.description: Find users by Amplitude ID, device ID, user ID, or a user ID prefix. Returns matching user summaries. Dashboard REST API: GET /api/2/usersearch.

user.description: Amplitude ID, device ID, user ID, or a user ID prefix.

tools.name: amplitude_user_activity
tools.title: User activity
tools.description: Event stream of one user, newest first by default. Use offset and limit to page. Dashboard REST API: GET /api/2/useractivity.

user.description: Amplitude ID of the user (from amplitude_search_users).

offset.description: Zero-indexed offset from the most recent event (default 0).

limit.description: Number of events to return, up to 1000 (default 100).

direction.description: Start from the earliest or the latest event (default latest).

tools.name: amplitude_get_chart_results
tools.title: Get saved chart results
tools.description: Results of a saved chart in the project, by chart ID (the ID in the chart's web address). Dashboard REST API: GET /api/3/chart/:chart_id/query.

chart_id.description: Chart ID from the chart's web address (for example abc123).
